t: Honduras left the Central American federation in 1838; Marco Aurelio Soto made Tegucigalpa its permanent capital in 1880.
American fruit companies dominated its north coast from the 1900s, and O. Henry coined ‘banana republic’ with Honduras in mind.
Dictatorship, military rule, the 1969 Football War, Contra bases and the 2009 coup have marked its modern history.
dyk: In 1911 the banana magnate Samuel Zemurray financed an invasion of Honduras that restored the former president Manuel Bonilla, who rewarded him with land concessions.
ev: Honduras declares its separation from the Federal Republic of Central America
Marco Aurelio Soto moves the capital from Comayagua to Tegucigalpa
Manuel Bonilla invades with mercenaries financed by Samuel Zemurray
Tiburcio Carías Andino begins sixteen years of rule
The great banana strike wins workers the right to organise
Honduras and El Salvador fight the Football War
The army removes President Manuel Zelaya in a coup
